description: This file contains a utility class for setting up and verifying the connection to a Consul service in tests, including methods to ensure the service is running and reachable.

classes.name: ConsulTestUtils
classes.description: A static utility class for Consul test setup and connection verification.

methods.name: EnsureConsul
methods.description: Checks if the Consul service is running; throws SkipException if not.

methods.name: EnsureConsulAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously verifies if the Consul service is reachable by sending an HTTP GET request to its health endpoint.
